headline: Thanksgiving: three NFL games (Bears @ Lions, Eagles @ Cowboys, Chiefs @ Bills) and college tournaments. No NBA today.

record.label: Last board (Wed 11/25)
record.note: The Rams beat the Packers 26-13 (Under hit, counted twice) and Blake Corum ran for 184. Arizona State lost to LSU by 2 in double overtime (+4.5 covered, counted twice), and Utah State beat SMU 93-59 (Under hit, counted twice). Also hit: Wolves-Thunder Under, Jackson State, Southern, and LMU. Misses: Heat, Thunder -1.5, UConn, and two half-point losses (Spurs-Blazers finished at 227 on the Under 226.5, and Providence lost by 3 at +2.5). Rice, Marquette and Davidson aren't counted because they'd already started when the board went out. Fourth winning board in a row. The board is down about 2.7 units since Oct 2.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Wednesday this tab went 3-0. Today no game has all sources agreeing, so these are the two strongest 2-to-1 picks.

straight.reasoning: CBS Sports' Mike Tierney and Fantasy Life both take the Under, and SportsBettingDime takes the Over. Rain, temperatures in the 30s, and gusts over 20 mph are forecast in Buffalo. Kansas City's defense allows 16.3 points a game (2nd in the NFL), its top running back Kenneth Walker is out, and Buffalo's last four games all went Under. Some books have 48; take the highest number you see. Playable to 47; skip at 46.5.

Yahoo takes the Lions +1.5 and SportsBettingDime takes Detroit to win outright; VSiN takes the Bears. Detroit has won six straight, gets points at home, protects the ball (7 turnovers to Chicago's 19), and has a better red-zone rate. The defense has improved since Brian Branch returned. Some books have Lions +2.5, which is better. Playable to +1; skip at pick'em.

straight.reasoning: Two of three sources like Detroit. Take +2.5 if you see it. Playable to +1.
Two of three sources take the Under, and rain and wind are forecast. Playable to 47.

props.reasoning: Extra pick. SportsBettingDime: backup Roschon Johnson didn't practice (ankle), and Swift has averaged 16.8 carries a game. Some books list this as over 13.5 attempts.
Extra pick, low confidence. Covers projects 288 yards: Goff's passer rating indoors is 103 against 93 outdoors, and the Bears have given up more big plays lately. Price is an estimate.
Extra pick. Covers: he's cleared 43.5 in 8 of 10 games, and wet, windy weather should mean more short passes to him. He also leads the Chiefs in target share. Price is an estimate; skip above 45.5.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Thanksgiving tournaments: Tennessee vs Iowa State, St. John's vs Louisville, Gonzaga vs Baylor (late). Every pick today comes from one source, so they're all extra picks at a quarter unit. Times are PT.

straight.reasoning: Extra pick. Dimers' model gives Texas a 57% chance to cover (4.7% edge). Playable to -9.

Extra pick. RotoWire: both teams are top-five in adjusted defense, Iowa State shoots poorly from three, and Tennessee holds opponents under 33% on twos. Dimers' headline college game today is this one too. Price is an estimate; playable to 138.5.

Extra pick. RotoWire: St. John's has covered five straight and has one of the best defenses in the country. Louisville rarely forces turnovers and makes only 66% of its free throws. Price is an estimate; playable to -2.5.
Extra pick. RotoWire: about 42% of Creighton's points come from threes, and TCU limits three-point attempts, takes care of the ball, and gets to the line. Price is an estimate.
Extra pick. Dimers' model gives SMU a 55.2% chance to cover (4.2% edge). SMU lost badly to Utah State yesterday, and LSU went to double overtime against Arizona State. Playable to +5.
Extra pick. Dimers' model gives Oregon a 54.7% chance to cover (5.2% edge). Late tip. Playable to +9.
